Kaya (Support): Heads-up escalation for Nimbus trial (tenant: nimbus-eval-7). Customers report repeated 502s on embeddings during their onboarding import. They have a customer-facing walkthrough in ~6 hours and a renewal checkpoint in 5 days. Need CS lead + immediate mitigation and comms. :warning:
Dan (CS): Taking CS lead. Can someone paste the support trace and tenant quota numbers? I'll schedule a 20m emergency call and draft an external note.
Kaya (Support): Trace snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 502
{"error":"upstream_reset","request_id":"req_c9b2f"}
Trace: embed-proxy -> prefix-cache -> worker-timeout
```
Kaya (Support): Also saw a burst of concurrent jobs from their CI integration; logs show 120 parallel ingest threads at peak.
Ben (Eng): Likely prefix cache eviction + worker queue saturation. Short-term options: 1) Temporarily cap parallel ingest for tenant, 2) route tenant to a lower-utilization pool, 3) bump tenant quota limits for token throughput. I can flip routing immediately if CS approves. Command to run: `redwoodctl route set nimbus-eval-7 --pool=us-central-low`
Priyanka (AM): Customer will demo externally at 14:00 local. If not resolved this could impact renew/expansion. They signaled interest in a larger seat package if demo succeeds. I'll be on the customer call.
Dan (CS): Comms plan draft: (A) Immediate outbound: short apology + status + 20m triage slot in 15m. (B) If mitigation holds: 30m remediation session + offer $600 credit and 10 days trial extension. (C) Post-call: update renewal brief and ask AM to delay renewal ask by 7 days. Priyanka ok to approve credit? :memo:
Priyanka (AM): Approve $600 credit + 10-day extension. Please use apologetic but concise wording. Approved. :+1:
Kaya (Support): Customer agreed to a triage call in 12 minutes. I shared a temporary runbook (throttle + routes) and their SSO admin contact.
Ben (Eng): I've applied a route change to us-central-low and temporarily limited ingest concurrency for that tenant. Monitoring: error rate dropping from 8% -> 0.8% in 5m. I'll hold the route for 4 hours while we deploy a debounce on parallel prefix writes.
IncidentBot: Created ticket INC-2044-331; priority=P1; assignees=Dan (CS), Ben (Eng); created_at=1865432112
Dan (CS): Running triage call now with customer and Eng. Goal: validate demo path, deliver ingest script example, confirm SSO status.
Kaya (Support): Customer requested a sample Node ingest snippet and a one-pager SSO checklist. I'll attach their manifest and admin contact to the ticket.
Ben (Eng): Follow-ups: open PR for batching guard, add tenant-specific rate limiter, schedule possible hotfix window tonight if needed. Reverting route after 24h stable.
Dan (CS): Call complete  workaround validated; demo path exercised end-to-end. Customer appreciated the speed. Sending remediation summary and credit notice now. Flagging renewal as "watch" for follow-up in 4 days.
Priyanka (AM): I'll update the renewal brief with mitigation notes and schedule a proactive outreach in 4 days. If demo goes well, we'll prioritize upsell motion.
Kaya (Support): Ticket will stay open until follow-up confirmed. Logs and CI timeline added.
Dan (CS): Internal CRM snippet to paste: "Nimbus trial experienced 502s during bulk ingest due to prefix-cache eviction under concurrent writes from CI. Immediate mitigation: temporary route to low-util pool + ingest concurrency cap. Offered $600 credit + 10-day extension. Eng fix queued (debounce PR + tenant rate limiter). Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 4 days. Contacts: Dan (CS), Priyanka (AM)."
